## Plan → landed

| planned | landed |
|---|---|
| URL scheme `/entity/<type>/<name-slug>--<hash7>/`, hash authoritative + frozen | P35.29's `entity_url`/`entity_url_key` primitives consumed verbatim; `freeze_hashes` applies the foreign-uuid collision extension in sorted-id order — an issued hash is never rewritten or reissued |
| `sig.slug-history/1` append-only records | `policy/slug_history.py` — `merge_history` carries prior rows verbatim and appends terminal rows; `history_doc` emits the bound doc + refuses corrupt registries (two current keys, key retired twice, person row) |
| 301 rename/merge · 300 split · 410 withdrawal | `resolve_request` — the reference vocabulary: `/entity/` hash-authoritative 200/301-canonical/terminal; `/id/` 302-while-current → terminal status; unknown → honest 404 |
| `/id/` redirects to current URLs | 302 while the entity is current (a 301 would cache a movable target); a `renamed` row resolves `/id/` through its successor at 302 |
| person-name screen | `live`/`history_doc`/step-3 all exclude `person`; no label, key or row under any path (SIG-UI-112) |
| history feeds JUR-05's generator | `web/entity_slug_history.json` emitted by `build_spine_export` (`previous_entity_history` = the release-chain binding); `resolve_request` is the seam + `web/src/lib/entity-history.ts` its TS mirror |
| unique labels `(kind, release)` | `check_unique_labels` runs inside `build_spine_export` — a duplicate refuses the export (SIG-UI-111) |
| ADR | `docs/adr/ADR-227-*.md` + registrations (appF, ADR_TRIGGERS quiet row, BL-086, adr index, spec rebuild, CHANGELOG) |

## Deviations (recorded, not smoothed)

- **Publication withdrawal scrubs; lifecycle withdrawal tombstones.**
  The ticket's "410 on withdrawal" is the K2 lifecycle `withdrawn`
  row — kept verbatim for unexplained absences. A P34.19
  publication withdrawal is stronger (F-337: the id may not appear in
  any public artifact — even a 410 tombstone names it), so
  `merge_history`'s `withdrawn=` input drops those entities' rows
  entirely and filters them out of merge/split targets. Caught by
  `test_p34_19` mid-run (the first cut emitted a tombstone naming the
  withdrawn uuid); recorded as ADR-227 §8.
- **Size over the S budget** — see Size.
- **`SIG_GCP_PROJECT`/`test_serving_topology`/`test_p34_18_aliases`
  local profile** — environmental/pre-existing, identical to the
  base's record; CI is authoritative.
- **Closeout repair arc** — two forward repair commits precede this
  closeout (Boundary evidence): an inherited orient-probe overage on
  the impl head, then a reverted in-place PHASE LOG trim that tripped
  the append-only guard — the budget was repaired in the editable
  CURRENT STATE head instead.

## Cost/effort notes

- One implementation pass plus one semantics repair: the first cut
  treated `withdrawn=` as a tombstone row; `test_p34_19`'s
  leave-every-public-artifact leg caught the withdrawn uuid in the
  emitted history → the publication-withdrawal scrub semantics
  (ADR-227 §8) with merge/split target filtering. Two smaller
  repairs: rename dedup needed slug/URL identity in the key, and
  `/id/` merged resolution needed the stale-current filter (a
  verbatim-carried `current` row must not outrank its terminal row).
  The TS mirror carries the identical rule so the two resolvers
  cannot drift.
- Two CI repair commits in the fix arc (Boundary evidence): the
  inherited orient-probe overage surfaced on the impl head (the base
  dispatch commit never ran CI); the first repair trimmed a committed
  PHASE LOG line in place — legal under the 2 KiB entry budget but an
  append-only violation under BM-HIST-01 — reverted and repaired via
  the CURRENT STATE head instead.
